ns2:section.sectionText: Students in this class will take leadership roles in producing live and live to tape programming to be aired on UI7 and master skills in pre-production, production and post-production. Students will oversee one of two UI7 programs: a live production of Good Morning Illini or a live-to-tape production of Illini Sports Night. Registration by instructor permission. Meets with JOUR 217 (71402) and JOUR 317 (71403). Please note: Students who have completed JOUR 460 KRE GMI-TV Prod Producing (SP20 64206) should not register for JOUR 417. While the numbers are different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit and will not count toward graduation. Students registering for the duplicate credit course will be asked to drop. This section will have distributed attendance. You will receive an email from your instructor with specific attendance directives. Richmond 103, 109, and 110 may all be used for this course to maintain physical distancing guidelines.
